Medical Synthetic Imaging 2023;9(5):401-419

Deep Learning for Histopathology Image Classification

Clara Jensen, Rashid Ali
Department of Medical Synthesis, University of Examples

Published 2023
DOI: 10.5555/synth.2023.110

Abstract
We train deep networks for histopathology image classification on synthetic slides.
Stain normalization and patch sampling are evaluated systematically.
Results show robust performance across synthetic cohorts.

Supplementary methods describe synthetic slide generation, augmentation policies, and evaluation protocols.
